Sand Hill Global Advisors Has Raised Its Stake in Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) by $389,820; Sony (SNE) Market Valuation Rose While Freestone Capital Holdings Has Raised Position by $1.89 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Russell Anderson
Freestone Capital Holdings Llc increased its stake in Sony Corp (SNE) by 37.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Freestone Capital Holdings Llc bought 42,919 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.79% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 158,429 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.12 million, up from 115,510 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Freestone Capital Holdings Llc who had been investing in Sony Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $61.49 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $0.255 during the last trading session, reaching $48.345. About 412,375 shares traded. Sony Corporation (NYSE:SNE) has risen 47.34% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 35.79% the S&P500.
Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc increased its stake in Intuitive Surgical Inc (ISRG) by 200% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc bought 1,068 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 1,602 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $585,000, up from 534 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
